name: io.github.shekibahmed/chatterpilot
title: ChatterPilot
description: Turn WhatsApp order exports into source-linked drafts a person reviews.

packageArguments.name: --files
packageArguments.description: Folder that file arguments must stay inside. Defaults to the current directory.

packageArguments.name: --profile
packageArguments.description: lite is read-only and the default. full adds import, catalogue load and draft edits.

packageArguments.name: --agent
packageArguments.description: Name recorded on drafts and edits made with the full profile

packageArguments.name: --transport
packageArguments.description: Serve streamable HTTP instead of stdio

packageArguments.name: --host
packageArguments.description: Bind address. Defaults to loopback. Any other address requires --token.

packageArguments.name: --port
packageArguments.description: Port for the streamable HTTP endpoint
